entries.why: A CAP-40 signed-payload signer (P...) has a 68-byte strkey payload; before the fix the signer column encoder accepted only 32-byte account/contract keys, so the ledger indexes but cannot be persisted.

Protocol 30 golden whose ledger headers use STELLAR_VALUE_SIGNED_MS (StellarValueType 3). go-stellar-sdk v0.7.3, used by 2a0a84e, predates that value; v0.8.0, used by 3e22515, decodes it. The harness must report this as a protocol gap, not as a failure.

golden_replay.why: Every protocol 30 golden must index and persist on HEAD with no decode error, indexer error, panic or dropped transaction.
